description:
Join Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems and drive innovation that matters! We build and seamlessly integrate technologies that enrich people’s lives and deliver the absolute best user-experience. As part of the Wi-Fi software development team, we make decisions that influence the connectivity experience on products people use every single day, across the world. Do you want to learn more about Wi-Fi and other wireless technologies? If your answer is yes, we may have the job for you!

Description
The job entails refining existing features, proactively developing new features within the Wi-Fi stack to cater to both new and existing use cases on Apple products. The role necessitates leveraging cutting-edge tools such as AI and machine learning to enhance product quality and streamline development and triage processes. The position requires leading cross-functional projects that involve collaboration with multiple external or vendor teams effectively. This role is not ideal for individuals who prefer working on independent tasks that do not require collaboration.

Responsibilities
Ownership of Wi-FI features, developing professional relationships and trust among key cross-functional stack holders, holistically looking at customer issues and figuring out smart ways of solving those problems in a large scale deployment.

Minimum qualifications
You have experience on Wireless connectivity SW development
You have exposure to interaction of L1/L2/L3, AI/ML tools
You have experience delivering SW features on large scale deployments and maintaining and polishing the developed SW over multiple years
You have experience with C/C++, Python, Data interpretation, and Telemetry
You have experience with multi-layer SW architecture on embedded platforms
You thrive in a collaborative environment and can clearly communicate while driving multiple projects across teams
You are laser-focused on the smallest details that are meaningful to our customers

Preferred qualifications
You demonstrate curiosity, courage, innovation and discipline
You have experience with Wi-Fi & Bluetooth
You have experience on automotive and car infotainment system / Android Auto
You have experience using AI/ML to enhance product quality and streamline development and triage processes
You are obsessively passionate and inquisitive, and seek to tackle everyday problems in innovative ways
